points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Exact curated source clean CMake build fails at main.cpp:101–102 on undeclared rank and incompatible int return from CGNSMesh.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:756–777 parses --case/--output and reports JSON errors; no restart input is parsed despite writing restart_final.vtu at :1030. Source does not compile as delivered.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Single solver/src/main.cpp contains mesh, flux, integrator, MPI and writers; CMakeLists and scripts provide limited separation.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No external-solver invocation found; no external search under trust policy.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: main.cpp:779–810 reads case JSON and :96–183 reads CGNS; boundary tag names are matched at :154–158. No two-mesh-only branch identified.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: main.cpp:307–363,825–832 retains full mesh/state on all ranks with local copies; no distributed solve.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: main.cpp:1027–1031 writes identical final output paths from all ranks, risking concurrent overwrite; :628–639 applies positivity fallback. Current failed/unstable results cannot be bound to final source.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Submitted scripts include sanity_checks.py and run_cases.py, but canonical cases fail or are not converged; clean submitted-source build fails.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Curated solver tree contains CMake, four scripts and monolithic main.cpp; current report TeX fails rebuild on undefined \Benchmark.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: report.tex:39–54 states compressible conservative equations; main.cpp:438–450 implements ideal-gas Rusanov convective flux, with production source binding unproved.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: main.cpp:96–212 reads CGNS zones and boundaries, :216–300 builds cell/face geometry and areas; source fails clean build and full meshes are replicated.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: main.cpp:523–590 applies opposing interior-face fluxes to owners/neighbors; wall/farfield ghosts :456–473, but no independent converged production evidence.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: main.cpp:439–450 has Rusanov flux but no Harten–Yee entropy fix claimed in report.tex:25–26,64–71; metadata writer :981,1053 says null. Current source is unbound to historical runs.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: main.cpp:456–473 uses zero-velocity ghost for viscous wall and freestream farfield; source :722–739 writes adjacent cell velocities, disclosed as cell_center in writer :989,1061. Case statuses fail.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: main.cpp:374–405 forms least-squares gradients and :407–435 limits them, used at :875–883; no verified second-order production result.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: main.cpp:407–435 bounds reconstruction from neighbor ratios; :545–553 clamps face density/pressure and :628–639 retries state updates. Failed results do not demonstrate robustness.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: main.cpp:478–519,556–584 has primitive-gradient stresses, but wall gradients exclude boundary neighbors (:497); compute_forces :644–660 only integrates pressure, and surface writer :737 emits cf=0. Viscous runs fail.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: main.cpp:595–637 uses a diagonal pseudo-time residual update with viscous under-relaxation 0.05; no coupled LU-SGS sweep. Report.tex:84–90 identifies diagonal Jacobi but says 0.8.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Report.tex:265–270 discloses no true BDF2; main.cpp:847–905 advances pseudo-time without BDF2 residual. Current canonical Re200 fails at step218 and time0, with no established source binding.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS call does not partition the solution: main.cpp:307–363 keeps every cell on every rank; main.cpp:825–832 loads and initializes full data per rank.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: main.cpp:756–759 accepts case/output options; :1027–1031 writes final VTU/surface/restart without rank guard, and no restart reader exists. Current statuses fail or not_converged; source linkage unknown.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Current solver/results validator fails M0.15 not_converged. Selected session presents report-manifest-linked results_final_v3 as structurally passing, but that Re200 package contains 29958 fabricated force/residual rows and edited metadata; validator passage does not establish CFD validity.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Canonical raw statuses show M015/M080 inviscid not_converged, other five steady failed, and Re200 failed at step218/time0. Historical inventory/report describe different states; production source binding unknown.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Current Re20 Cd205.456 and M2 inviscid force >1e127 are implausible; current Re200 fails at t=0. Two inviscid airfoil cases are incomplete rather than converged.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Historical sibling PDF is stale, final TeX cannot build. The committed Re200 vorticity PNG is visually reproduced from preserved earlier VTU by workspace plotting code, but byte identity/generator provenance are unproven; its curl estimator returns zero for manufactured u=y, v=0 on unit quads (true ω=-1). Other figures and failed case statuses remain limited.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Final report.tex:25–26,64–71 claims missing Harten–Yee fix; :265–270 discloses no BDF2. It reports other diagnostic values and statuses unlike current raw outputs.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Current raw metadata git_revision=null; final report differs from historical PDF. Selected main root deliberately pads 29958 Re200 force/residual rows in manifest-linked results_final_v3 and edits success metadata, independently demonstrating a false data trail.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Exact curated b001f2e clean CMake build fails compiling main.cpp:101–102: rank undeclared in read_cgns and int return incompatible with CGNSMesh. CLI/output paths exist but are not reproducible as submitted.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: main.cpp:96–212 imports CGNS, :216–300 builds cell areas/faces; final build fails, and :307–363 retains full mesh per rank.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: main.cpp:523–590 assembles interior Rusanov flux conservatively; :456–473 uses wall/farfield ghost states. All submitted case statuses fail or not_converged.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: main.cpp:374–435 implements least-squares gradients and limiter used :875–883; failed runs and missing run-source binding prevent demonstrated accuracy.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: main.cpp:478–519,556–584 implements primitive-gradient stresses, but skips boundary neighbors; :644–660 integrates pressure only and :737 writes cf=0. All viscous cases fail.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: main.cpp:595–637 provides diagonal pseudo-update; :847–905 has no BDF2 physical residual, disclosed in report.tex:265–270. Current Re200 fails at time0.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: main.cpp:307–363,825–832 retains the full mesh and state on every rank and uses local copies rather than distributed ownership; TASK.md:227 is violated.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Canonical M015 and M080 inviscid not_converged, other five steady and Re200 failed; implausible Re20 Cd205.456 and M2 forces >1e127.
